description: This file contains unit tests for the session tab registry module, verifying tab tracking, untracking, and closing behaviors, including handling of deduplication and errors.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for session tab registry.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Setup function run before each test to reset the session tab registry state.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Cleanup function run after each test to reset the session tab registry state.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for the session tab registry.

methods.name: __countTrackedSessionBrowserTabsForTests
methods.description: Counts the number of tracked browser tabs for a given session key, used in tests.

methods.name: __resetTrackedSessionBrowserTabsForTests
methods.description: Resets the internal state of tracked session browser tabs, used in tests.

methods.name: closeTrackedBrowserTabsForSessions
methods.description: Closes browser tabs tracked for specified session keys.

methods.name: trackSessionBrowserTab
methods.description: Tracks a new browser tab associated with a session.

methods.name: untrackSessionBrowserTab
methods.description: Removes a tab from session tracking.
